managed_custody_rules.description: Uses object.ReferenceEquals(x, null) and object.ReferenceEquals(a, b) exclusively for null and owner verification in CleanupOwnerPendingHandoff, CleanupEscapingAddComponentFailure, and TryAcquirePendingStartupHandoff.
managed_custody_rules.proof_witness: Bypasses UnityEngine.Object overloaded operator== so that native-null wrappers on destroyed GameObjects can never bypass matching managed payload cleanup.

managed_custody_rules.description: Establishes _isPairRequiredMode = true from static marker _staticPairModeRequired under lock BEFORE reading this.gameObject. Retains managed owner in _retainedOwner inside try/catch. Checks _staticStartupAborted prior abort before resource setup.
managed_custody_rules.proof_witness: If process startup was previously aborted, clears matching payload under lock if retained owner matches, sets _startupInitializationComplete = false, isRunning = false, and returns immediately before fastEcology, log callback, policy, listener, or thread creation.

managed_custody_rules.description: Awake catch tail marks _startupInitializationComplete = false, isRunning = false, and _staticStartupAborted = true. Logging is protected inside try/catch so logging exceptions cannot skip cleanup. Each resource cleanup attempt is independently protected.
managed_custody_rules.proof_witness: Independently guarded: HandleUnityLogMessage unsubscribe, listener?.Stop(), listenerThread?.Abort(), and CleanupOwnerPendingHandoff(_retainedOwner).

managed_custody_rules.description: OnDestroy cleans _privatePairProfile, calls CleanupOwnerPendingHandoff(_retainedOwner) inside try/catch, guards error logging, and executes isRunning = false and resource stops inside a finally block.
managed_custody_rules.proof_witness: Guarantees resource teardown attempts execute unconditionally even if owner cleanup or catch logging throws.
